name.zh: 申根 / ICAO 生物识别照片（35×45 mm）

issuer: ICAO Doc 9303 / German Federal Foreign Office biometric photo rules

notes.en: The EU Visa Code requires a photograph meeting ICAO Doc 9303 portrait rules; ICAO Part 3 states submitted portraits should be 45.0 mm × 35.0 mm. This entry records the widely used 35×45 mm print plus the German Federal Foreign Office biometric measurements that implement the ICAO 70–80% face height (32–36 mm chin to crown on a 35×45 mm photo). Background is a single light colour, ideally neutral grey — no official hex. Pixel size, file limits, and DPI are not stated. Individual Schengen consulates may word height differently; check the consulate that will receive the application.
notes.zh: 欧盟签证法典要求照片符合 ICAO Doc 9303；ICAO 第 3 部分写明提交肖像应为 45.0 mm × 35.0 mm。本条记录常用的 35×45 mm，以及德国外交部生物识别尺寸：面部高度占照片 70–80%（35×45 mm 上为下巴到头顶 32–36 mm）。背景为单一浅色，理想为中性灰，无官方色值。未写像素、文件限制与 DPI。各申根馆表述可能不同，以受理馆为准。
